tab.title: Avatars
tab.intro: An avatar is a likeness of a real person, made from a few of their pictures, short videos and recordings. The person must agree, and you can withdraw that agreement or delete the avatar at any time.
tab.introBoth: This is where you keep the people and objects you want to show in your videos. A person is a likeness of a real person, made from a few of their pictures, short videos and recordings: the person must agree, and you can withdraw that agreement at any time. An object is a product, a vehicle, a building or anything else that is not a person, made from a few pictures of it. You can delete either one at any time.
tab.introObjects: An object is a product, a vehicle, a building or anything else that is not a person. Add a few clear pictures of it and you can show it in your videos. You can delete it at any time.
